name: track random irregularities
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 作为随机过程或随机场描述的轨道几何偏差。
usage_overview: 通常作为车辆—轨道系统的随机几何激励，用于分析轮轨相互作用及动力响应的概率特征，也可与横风、车轮磨耗或扣件失效共同考虑。参数比较与优化分析中可采用相同不平顺样本，以比较不同参数组合下的响应。

complete_examples.text: Except for track random irregularities, the other basic measured data on railway infrastructures are not sufficient.
The track random irregularities at straight-line section are used as the excitations, which are randomly simulated in Section 2.3.
Currently, power spectral density (PSD) is widely used as a form of representation of track random irregularities.
Track random irregularities, as one of exciting sources of vehicle–track coupled model, can be simulated from track irregularity PSD generally.
While track random irregularities will be transformed from the PSD functions using a developed probabilistic method.
However, track random irregularities are objectively formed and will be continuously growing on rail surfaces.
Therewith, the simulation method of track random irregularities with characters of probabilistic ergodicity is arrived at.
As can be seen from Figs. 16–19, the amplitudes of fluctuations are obtained for rail displacement under the excitations of track random irregularities.
The vehicle-track coupled system is regarded as a stochastic nonlinear system when the excitations of cross-winds and track random irregularities are taken into consideration.

The Karhunen-Loève expansion method is applied to grasp the random features of fluctuating winds and the track random irregularities are generated by application of the track irregularity probabilistic model.
Meanwhile, a track irregularity probabilistic model was introduced to achieve the ergodic simulation of track random irregularities under different amplitude and frequency states.

By combining the vehicle-track coupled dynamics and probability theory, a vehicle-track stochastic dynamic model in which the wheel profile wear and track random irregularities are jointly used as the excitations was developed.
